title: The Echoing Peak
rumor: The Echoing Peak. There is a mountain where a shouted word returns not once, but seven times, each echo spoken in a different voice. Karrathi lore maintains that the mountain remembers every promise made upon its slopes. One old tale describes a warrior who climbed the peak to recover an oath forgotten by his ancestors.
first_lead: Karrathi wardens recognize the mountain by an unusual split in its summit.
